title: Cutting-Edge tools to build subscriptions
body: Our platform combines cutting-edge AI models with intuitive interfaces to streamline your development workflow and boost productivity.

card1.title: Component Kits & Campaigns
card1.body: Browse favorite kits, manage campaign timelines, and connect initiatives—all from a single organized view.

card2.title: Schedule & Compose
card2.body: Plan with calendar shortcuts and write with rich text tools—bold, italics, underline, and more—without leaving your flow.

card3.title: Dashboards & Usage
card3.body: Visualize key metrics with live cards and progress bars to monitor usage and spot trends at a glance.
